skills.name: Subtract aligned pure fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two pure fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and interpreting zero results when they occur.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike denominators and convert the relevant fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed-number or whole-number quantities by separating whole and fractional parts, subtracting aligned parts when the fractional subtraction is nonnegative, and recombining the result.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers with regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed-number or whole-number quantities when the fractional part would be negative by borrowing one or more wholes, converting each borrowed whole into denominator-over-denominator form, and recombining the result.

skills.name: Reduce fractional result
skills.definition: Simplify a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
